description: Internal docs row-level-security.md:190 and authentication/overview.md:113 still say caller metadata can only supply RLS predicate values; rule-set _meta keys now also select the guarding set.
docs/external/rule-sets.md refusal list is incomplete: no-such-rule-set also covers non-string/non-integer names, >64 _meta keys refusal unstated, owner and catalog refusals omitted.
Frozen rule-set record models hold mutable lists, so validated invariants can be broken after construction.
LoadedRuleSets is a mutable dataclass and CatalogConfirmation.confirmed is a public bool that could skip the catalog check.
RuleSetSelection validates nothing at construction; the guard trusts any published selection.
RuleSetsConfig._loaded is set from outside the class and can drift from file.
No test that list_data_sources answers a call with no _meta while a rule-set file is configured (criterion 32).
show_details profile under a rule set is only checked for selection, not end to end through the guard (criterion 34).
RefusalRedactingRunner's _logged_by_guard assumption (non-guard __cause__ means already logged) is unpinned by any test; raw readonly/rls raises from sqlglot errors do not log.
docs/external/rule-sets.md line 66 says confirmed_against_production = true is required, but the field is a required StrictBool: false loads, warns at startup, and its requests are refused.
